title: Skipping Benny Goodman's 1938 Carnegie Hall concert
summary: Greer never attended because he was always working.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: Were you at the Carnegie Hall Concert that Benny Goodman did when he had -- I mean, did you go to any with Johnny Hodges and Lester Young and some other people were in
a jam session part of that 1938 concert you did? You didn't go to the concert hall?

No, I never went to it. I never went to it. Not that I didn't want to, but man, we stayed out of New York so much, we got to New York and no one had a chance to hear me. I was with all them bands playing, all them different guys. Wasn't no big thrill to me. A lot of people went, but I mean, I had a lot of other things to do besides that.
